Company Description Finelbe Inspect, based in the Netherlands, is a pioneering company in international commodities trade and inspections, specializing in metals and minerals. The organization provides high-quality inspection services that ensure accurate assessment of product quality and quantity. With a team of experienced professionals, Finelbe Inspect delivers tailored solutions and expert guidance to meet diverse client needs. The company places strong emphasis on risk management, offering clients informed advice and continuous support. Finelbe Inspect operates on a 24/7 basis, ensuring reliable service and timely response across global markets.Role Description The Metals and Minerals Inspector is a full-time, hybrid role based in Lima, Peru, with the possibility to perform some duties from home. The inspector will conduct on-site inspections of metals and minerals at ports, warehouses, and production facilities, verifying quality, quantity, and compliance with contractual specifications and industry standards. Daily tasks include sampling and testing materials, preparing detailed inspection and risk assessment reports, and documenting findings in accordance with internal procedures and client requirements. The role involves close collaboration with operations, logistics, and client teams to coordinate inspections, resolve discrepancies, and provide clear, timely updates. The inspector will also support continuous improvement of inspection processes, maintain safety and regulatory compliance, and contribute insights to risk management and quality control activities.QualificationsTechnical knowledge of metals and minerals, including basic understanding of sampling, testing methods, and relevant industry standards.Experience in inspection, quality control, or commodities logistics, ideally within metals, minerals, or related industrial sectors.Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to interpret data, prepare clear inspection documents, and maintain accurate records.Effective communication and interpersonal skills for working with clients, terminal staff, and internal teams in multicultural environments.Attention to detail, reliability, and a high level of integrity in verifying quantities, quality, and compliance.Ability to work in field conditions, including on vessels, in warehouses, and at industrial sites, following strict safety procedures.Comfort with hybrid work arrangements and flexibility to work irregular hours or shifts, including evenings and weekends when required.Proficiency with standard office software and digital tools used for data entry, reporting, and documentation.Fluency in English; and SpanishRelevant vocational training or degree in engineering, materials science, logistics, or a related field is preferred.Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel to local ports, terminals, and client sites as needed.
